hero.title: ताम्रपाषाण युग: एक परिचय

traps.title: UPSC सामान्य जाल/भ्रम
items: ताम्रपाषाण को एक अखिल भारतीय शहरी घटना मानना; यह मुख्य रूप से ग्रामीण थी।
यह मानना कि तांबे का उपयोग हथियारों के लिए होता था; यह मुख्य रूप से छोटे औजारों और गहनों के लिए था।
चित्रित धूसर मृदभांड (लौह युग) और ब्लैक-ऑन-रेड वेयर (ताम्रपाषाण) के बीच भ्रमित होना।

deepDive.title: Syllabus Core Study Notes (Deep-Dive)
deepDive.description: Master the chronology, regional cultures, metallurgy, social structure, and burial customs of the Indian Chalcolithic phase.

sections.title: 1. Core Study Notes
sections.content:
भूगोल

  • अर्ध-शुष्क क्षेत्र
  • बनास घाटी (राजस्थान)
  • चंबल/नर्मदा बेसिन (म.प्र.)
  • गोदावरी बेसिन (महाराष्ट्र)

आर्थिक प्रोफाइल

  • कृषि-पशुपालक अर्थव्यवस्था
  • खेती: गेहूं, जौ, दालें
  • पशुपालन: मवेशी, भेड़, बकरी

सांस्कृतिक संरचना

  • बस्तियां: छोटी बस्तियाँ, गोलाकार/आयताकार मिट्टी के घर।
  • प्रौद्योगिकी: तांबे का सीमित उपयोग; पत्थर के ब्लेड अभी भी प्रमुख थे।
  • दफन संस्कार: विस्तारित दफन (महाराष्ट्र में उत्तर-दक्षिण दिशा)।
  • मृदभांड: 'ब्लैक-ऑन-रेड वेयर' इस काल की पहचान है।
संस्कृतिक्षेत्रप्रमुख विशेषताएँ
आहार/बनासराजस्थानपत्थर के घर, तांबा गलाने के प्रमाण
कायथामध्य प्रदेशसमृद्ध तांबे की वस्तुएं
जोरवेमहाराष्ट्रबड़ी बस्तियां, टोंटीदार बर्तन

flashcards.title: Active Recall Flashcards
flashcards.description: Hover or click to flip the card and test your retention of key Chalcolithic facts.

cards.back: It is derived from the Greek words khalkos (copper) and lithos (stone), representing the Copper-Stone Age.

cards.front: Which site yielded the famous solid copper chariot driver, elephant, bull, and rhino?
cards.back: Daimabad in Ahmednagar district, Maharashtra, belonging to the late Jorwe phase (c. 1400–700 BCE).

cards.front: What was the typical burial orientation in Maharashtra Chalcolithic sites?
cards.back: North-South orientation. Skeletons were buried under house floors, often with lower leg bones chopped off to prevent the spirit from returning.

cards.front: Which regional Chalcolithic culture is renowned for the highest variety of painted pottery?
cards.back: The Malwa Culture (sites: Navdatoli, Eran). Its pottery was richly slip-painted with geometric and animal motifs.
Caches of heavy copper implements (flat celts, harpoons, swords, anthropomorphic shapes) found in the Ganga-Yamuna doab, dating to c. 2000-1500 BCE.

cards.front: Which site shows an extensive irrigation canal and mud fortification?
cards.back: Inamgaon in Pune district, Maharashtra, excavated by H.D. Sankalia and M.K. Dhavalikar.

rules: Each incorrect answer deducts 0.66 marks (1/3rd penalty).
Questions match the current UPSC Prelims standards (multi-statement and matching pairs).

practiceQuestions.q: Which of the following cultures are classified under the Indian Chalcolithic phase? (Select all that apply)
practiceQuestions.sol: Malwa, Jorwe, and Ahar are Chalcolithic; Magdalenian is a European Upper Paleolithic culture.

practiceQuestions.q: The type site of Ahar culture, historically famous as Tambavati, is located in which modern state?
practiceQuestions.sol: Ahar is located in the Udaipur district of Rajasthan.

mockTestQuestions.q:
With reference to protohistoric Inamgaon site, consider the following statements:
1. It belongs to the Jorwe culture of Deccan.
2. A large irrigation canal and mud fortification have been excavated.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
mockTestQuestions.sol: Both statements are correct. Inamgaon is a key Jorwe site with fortifications and floodwater canal structures.
